title: AtlaSent Protection Catalog
description: Deterministic Canon-first discovery projection. Action maturity exists only inside pack memberships, and system proof remains within each action pack's system binding profiles.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON for the current pack with version_history omitted, object keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', and non-ASCII characters preserved. Null until the version is released.

maturity.description: Independent axes; consumers must not collapse these values into a synthetic production-ready flag.
